title: Atendente de Farmácia - Recreio
description:
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar em escala 6x1.
  • Experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Analista Técnico de Vendas Sr (Ciências Náuticas / Operações Marítimas de Óleo e Gás) | B2B
description:
Job description

Somos a VIBRA! A maior distribuidora de combustível do país! Uma empresa pronta para o futuro com uma bagagem de 50 anos de história. Atuamos para impulsionar pessoas e negócios, abrindo novos caminhos. Estamos sempre a postos para mover o Brasil com sua melhor energia. Enfrentamos os nossos desafios com coragem para mudar, confiança para inspirar e felicidade para evoluir. Somos movidos pelos nossos clientes, simplificamos o dia a dia com ousadia para ir além. Somos um time que vibra e nos comprometemos com o futuro sustentável. Esse é o nosso propósito e os nossos princípios!

Main responsibilities

  • Planejamento e controle das entregas offshore de materiais e do ressuprimento dos navios de supply, minimizando riscos operacionais e otimizando a eficiência logística;
  • Implementação de procedimentos adequados para carga e descarga de combustíveis, lubrificantes, produtos químicos e demais materiais transportados nos portos e plataformas;
  • Conhecimento das melhores práticas e softwares de monitoramento de tráfego marítimo e clima disponíveis – SAP (Módulos de Supply Chain e Logística), Corsarius, Marine Traffic, Vessel Finder, OceanOPS, entre outros;
  • Assegurar a aderência das operações às regulamentações marítimas, ambientais e de segurança operacional, em especial as da MARPOL, NORMAM, ISPS Code, ANP, ISM e IBAMA;
  • Supervisionar inspeções e certificações necessárias para a operação dos navios, desde requisitos do OCIMF e inspeções SIRE das embarcações até certificações de magotes, fluxometros, entre outros;
  • Acompanhar KPIs de eficiência operacional, consumo de combustível e taxa de entregas dentro do prazo, tomando as iniciativas cabíveis quando necessário;
  • Supervisionar a gestão de medições para cobranças de clientes, proformas dos armadores e pagamentos a parceiros logísticos contratados (portos, prestadores de serviços etc.);
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos e melhoria da eficiência logística;
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais para a gestão comercial;
  • Atuar como interface com terminais portuários, clientes e fornecedores para alinhamento das operações;
  • Gerenciar prazos e exigências de vetting das embarcações contratadas pelos clientes, realizando as interfaces necessárias entre clientes e armadores;
  • Apoiar negociações técnicas e assegurar o cumprimento dos contratos operacionais;
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com clientes, reuniões internas e outras que se fizerem necessárias para suporte técnico operacional ao time comercial;
  • Responsável comercial por tratativas com clientes em casos de claims e apuração de intercorrências, como atrasos de entregas, contaminações de produto, contestações e cartas protesto em geral;
  • Liderar, em conjunto com o time operacional, análises de causa raiz em casos de não conformidade ou problemas nas operações, realizando interface entre cliente, armador, Vibra e outros envolvidos;
  • Desenvolver aos times de logística e operações, planos de contingência para falhas operacionais, climáticas ou incidentes ambientais;
  • Atuar na gestão de compliance e mitigação de riscos ambientais, incluindo respostas a incidentes;
  • Conhecimento avançado de processos e procedimentos de movimentação de carga nos portos e plataformas, incluindo: Paletização de materiais; Uso adequado de cestas e contêineres offshore; Slings e amarração de carga; Operação de guindastes e movimentação de cargas; Manuseio de produtos perigosos; Aplicação de checklists de segurança.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Náuticas;
  • Inglês em nível avançado (oral e escrito).

Diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia na área offshore

Additional information

E tem mais, confira o nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes
  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual
  • Convênio Farmácia . Descontos de até 70%
  • Previdência Complementar – Plano FlexPrev - variando de 1% a 11%, de acordo com o salário
  • Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação.
  • Extensão das Licenças - Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias).
  • Vale-Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Caju Benefícios
  • Auxílio-Educação
  • Wellhub/Gympass
  • Adicional por tempo de serviço – Oferecemos ao colaborador um adicional de salário (de acordo ao tempo de casa) a ser pago por ocasião de férias.

E para o desenvolvimento de nossas equipes...

  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem: Trilha dos valores vibra e curadoria renomada com mais de 200 opções de cursos disponíveis para acesso a qualquer tempo.
  • Recrutamento Interno: Divulgação das vagas disponíveis em todo Brasil, incentivando a mobilidade interna.

description:
Cargo: Museólogo(a) Pleno

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Museólogo(a), para atuar em conservação e pesquisa do acervo museológico do Clube de Regatas do Flamengo. Responsável por dar continuidade ao trabalho de conservação preventiva em objetos museológicos em reserva técnica e em exposição. Desenvolver documentação museológica incluindo inventário, laudo técnico e catalogação subsidiados por pesquisa histórica do objeto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Documentação museológica: desenvolver atividades de inventário, catalogação e laudo técnico conforme as normas do ICOM e Diretrizes do Sistema Brasileiro de Museus; controlar os processos de aquisição, empréstimo e circulação de acervo.
  • Pesquisa: produzir pesquisas para relacionar a trajetória do objeto contribuindo para preservação da memória institucional.
  • Conservação (curativa e preventiva): avaliar, implementar e monitorar ações de conservação do acervo museológico, em reserva e em exposição.
  • Software de gestão de acervo: alimentar e atualizar o banco de dados e sistemas de gestão museológica (In Patrimonium).
  • Exposição: apoio no planejamento conceitual e curatorial de exposições de curta e longa duração; auxiliar nos roteiros expográficos, textos curatoriais e seleção de objetos; acompanhar processos de montagem e desmontagem de exposições, garantindo integridade do acervo.
  • Acervos em itinerância: acompanhar deslocamento de acervo museológico, em transporte, e montagem e desmontagem de exposições fora da instituição. Com disponibilidade para viagens, caso necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Museologia.
  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Museologia 2ª Região (COREM 2R), com a devida apresentação da Certidão de Registro e Regularidade.
  • Experiência com documentação museológica.
  • Experiência com pesquisa museológica.
  • Experiência em conservação preventiva.
  • Experiência com montagem e desmontagem de exposições.

Será um diferencial:

  • Pós-graduação (cursando ou completa) em Museologia, História, Arquivologia, Biblioteconomia ou Conservação e Restauro.
  • Experiência de softwares de gestão de acervo museológico.
  • Experiência com processos curatoriais.
  • Experiência em intervenção química/higienização em metais históricos.
  • Experiência em intervenção química/higienização em têxteis históricos.
  • Pesquisas na área do esporte, com foco no Clube de Regatas do Flamengo.
  • Inglês intermediário.

description:
Overview

Rede D'Or Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Desc

Requisitos

  • Formação: Curso técnico em enfermagem.
  • Registro no conselho ativo e em regularidade.
  • Desejável vivência nas rotinas do CME.

Atividades

  • Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade no início do plantão, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu atendimento.
  • Assumir as funções inerentes ao Técnico de Enfermagem Diarista na ausência do mesmo, visando dar continuidade e encaminhamento ao expediente do Setor.
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente internado no setor, realizando diversas atividades, tais como: higiene ocular, oral, íntima e corporal, aferição de peso, medir diurese, administrar medicamentos, mudança de decúbito, aspiração de vias aéreas superiores, traqueostomia e tubo oro faríngeo, entre outros, conforme definido nos POPs (Procedimento Operacional Padrão) definidos pela Unidade, visando resolver todas as intercorrências.
  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os Médicos ou Enfermeiros nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: punções venosas profundas, punções arteriais médias, intubações, entre outras, bem como providenciando o descarte dos materiais utilizados.
  • Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela Unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas especificadas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente.
  • Conferir e repor o Carro e Maleta de Parada Cardiorrespiratória, após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações.
  • Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seu cuidado, notificando imediatamente aos enfermeiros e registrando na evolução do balanço hídrico qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.
  • Cumprir as orientações definidas em prescrição Médica, para preparo dos pacientes para realização de exames e/ou cirurgias, tais como manutenção de jejum, preparo de cólon, entre outros, a fim de garantir a continuidade do tratamento.
  • Observar previsões de altas e possíveis transferências, com objetivo de priorizar os cuidados, agilizando o processo.
  • Instalar no paciente os equipamentos de monitorização, como bombas infusoras e monitores cardíacos, conforme orientação médica.
  • Preparar corpo do paciente nos casos de óbito, a fim de encaminhá-lo ao Morgue.
  • Realizar a aplicação de compressas quentes e frias, conforme prescrição médica, assegurando a integridade cutânea do paciente.
  • Devolver medicações e materiais do cliente em caso de altas, transferências, óbitos ou em caso de modificações de prescrições, todos devidamente identificados com etiqueta do cliente.
  • Providenciar a devolução dos medicamentos e materiais não utilizados pelos pacientes, fazendo lançamento através do Sistema Phostos, garantindo a confirmação do processo.
  • Checar e rubricar todos os medicamentos prescritos e administrados, lançando no balanço hídrico horário de início de dieta, transporte de soluções, infusões, medicações SOS e ACM, assim como valor de glicemia, diurese e eliminações, controlar o balanço hídrico rigorosamente.
  • Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.
  • Auxiliar os pacientes na ingestão de alimentos, quando necessário.
  • Conferir e testar equipamentos e/ou materiais dos boxes/quartos, sob sua responsabilidade, verificando o perfeito estado de funcionamento e utilização dos mesmos, quando da entrada de novos pacientes.
  • Admitir o paciente junto ao enfermeiro, realizando conferência dos sinais vitais, identificando o cliente com pulseira.
  • Retirar todo material e equipamentos, realizar a higiene dos mesmos e armazená-los em local adequado, em caso de altas, transferências e óbitos.
  • Informar ao enfermeiro plantonista, problemas com equipamentos para que sejam comunicados aos serviços de apoio (engenharia clínica, hotelaria, manutenção predial, supervisão da higiene).
  • Preencher livro de protocolo, no plantão noturno, em caso de empréstimos de equipamento e/ou materiais para outros Setores de Enfermagem.

Outras Informações

  • Local de trabalho: Freguesia, Jacarepaguá, Rio de Janeiro - RJ.
  • Escala de trabalho: À combinar.
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Técnico Em Saúde Bucal
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil? Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas. Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco. O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

Responsabilidades

  • Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista.
  • Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços.
  • Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como: segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos.
  • Fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária.
  • Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas.
  • Fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional; zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondicionar e esterilizar materiais e equipamentos utilizados.
  • Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho (consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção).
  • Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitação dos materiais via sistema e cotação de compra dos materiais emergenciais para as clínicas, realizar cefalometrias e as fotos para documentação de ortodontia dos pacientes, quando necessário.
  • Realização de procedimentos básicos junto aos pacientes (remoção de sutura, higiene oral, tomada de radiografias) sempre com supervisão do dentista.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior.

Qualificações

title: Técnico de Fibra Óptica Júnior
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Estamos buscando umTécnico de Fibra Óptica Júnior que será responsável por garantir a integridade, o desempenho e a continuidade das redes de fibra óptica por meio da execução precisa de instalações, fusões, testes e manutenções em campo, assegurando a conformidade técnica, a qualidade dos enlaces e o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de segurança, além de colaborar com as equipes de engenharia e operação para entregar serviços confiáveis e de alta performance.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

Seus desafios serão:

  • Realizar instalação, fusão (splicing), emenda e certificação de cabos de fibra óptica em campo.
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em redes ópticas, garantindo a qualidade e integridade dos enlaces.
  • Utilizar equipamentos de medição como OTDR, certificadores de fibra, microscópios, power meters, entre outros.
  • Realizar testes de atenuação, perda óptica e reflectância para garantir o desempenho dos enlaces.
  • Interpretar projetos, diagramas e esquemas de redes ópticas para execução dos serviços.
  • Registrar e documentar todos os serviços realizados, reportando eventuais problemas e soluções adotadas.
  • Seguir normas de segurança do trabalho e procedimentos técnicos específicos para trabalhos em altura, espaços confinados e manuseio de equipamentos sensíveis.
  • Apoiar a equipe em atividades de instalação e ativação de equipamentos associados à rede óptica, como OLTs, ONTs, splitters e acessórios.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de engenharia e operação para garantir a qualidade e continuidade dos serviços.
  • Seguir normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais da empresa.

O que é necessário você ter:

description:
Mecânico de Refrigeração - Equipe de Cobertura RJ

Vaga: Mecânico de Refrigeração – Equipe de Cobertura (Rio de Janeiro). Estamos buscando um Mecânico de Refrigeração para atuar na equipe de cobertura que atende diferentes contratos em toda a cidade do Rio de Janeiro. A equipe de cobertura não possui posto ou horário fixo; as atividades são direcionadas conforme as demandas diárias informadas pela equipe operacional, que define local, escala e período. O salário é fixo, independentemente da cobertura realizada, e nos dias sem demanda o colaborador permanece na base de um contrato até surgir um novo chamado. As folgas são sempre respeitadas conforme a escala. Essa equipe também é responsável por cobrir ausências por faltas, férias ou atestados.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas de climatização, incluindo Chiller, Fancoil, Self-Contained, Split e ar-condicionado de janela.
  • Executar regulagem de temperaturas, medições de pressão e amperagem.
  • Limpeza de serpentinas, evaporadores, condensadores, bandejas e drenos.
  • Substituição de compressores, motores, filtros secadores, válvulas de expansão, rolamentos, correias, contactores e outros componentes.
  • Efetuar revisão elétrica, reaperto de conexões, lavagem e varetamento de condensadores, manutenção de torres de resfriamento e bombas de água gelada ou condensada.
  • Realizar vácuo, carga e recarga de gás refrigerante, limpeza de tubulações com nitrogênio e inspeção de anomalias, garantindo o pleno desempenho dos sistemas.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em refrigeração.
  • Disponibilidade total de horário para atuar em equipe de cobertura.
  • Certificado na área de refrigeração será considerado diferencial.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview

viaPeople is seeking a driven Senior Full Stack Engineer whose core expertise lies in modern TypeScript-based front‑end development (React) and building robust Node.js APIs that leverage AWS services.

You’ll lead end‑to‑end feature development on our new cloud platform, designing UI components, authoring backend endpoints, and integrating with AWS resources.

Familiarity with Java / Spring Boot is a welcome plus as our legacy system is built on this. We value your React / Node / AWS experience above all. This is a high‑impact role: you’ll architect and build new services, establish best practices, and help shape the future of our platform.

You’ll collaborate directly with the founder and cross‑functional teams, take ownership of technical decisions, and mentor others as we grow.

What You’ll Do

  • Frontend Engineering: Build responsive, accessible UIs using React with TypeScript, architect scalable component libraries and design systems, implement front‑end testing (Jest, React Testing Library) and CI workflows.
  • Backend / API Development: Design, build, and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs in Node.js (Express, Serverless), integrate with AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, S3, RDS / DynamoDB), optimize performance, security, and cost across your services.
  • Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Deploy and monitor applications in AWS, automate releases with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline), leverage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Collaboration & Ownership: Partner with product, design, and QA to deliver high‑quality features, lead code reviews, pair programming sessions, and design discussions, mentor junior engineers, and evangelize best practices.

You Might Be a Fit If You…

  • Have 5+ years as a full stack developer with a strong emphasis on React / TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Built and maintained production services on AWS, from Lambda functions to managed databases.
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code and enjoy automating deployment pipelines.
  • Thrive in a fast‑paced, remote team and take initiative to drive projects forward.
  • Value collaborative engineering practices: agile ceremonies, code reviews, and shared ownership.
  • Hold an AWS Certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) — or are eager to earn one.
  • Nice to have: Familiarity with Java / Spring Boot (legacy platform support or migration).
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, ECS / EKS) and background in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Worked on migrating monoliths to microservices or serverless architectures.

Position Details

Location: Remote (US‑Based, EST core hours preferred; flexible).

Engagement: Full‑time.

Start Date: Flexible within 30 days.

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience.

About viaPeople

viaPeople builds performance management tools for top investment firms and fast‑growing companies.

We’re a small, agile team focused on solving complex talent challenges with highly configurable software.

Our values guide us every day: Driven – we take initiative and exceed expectations; Trustworthy – we deliver with honesty and integrity; Growth Mindset – we embrace learning and continuous improvement; Solutions Oriented – we focus on solving, not dwelling on problems; Customer Centered – our clients’ success is our success.

If you’re passionate about modern web development, cloud architectures, and making a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide accommodations throughout the hiring process.

We are seeking a candidate in Brazil Region as Medical Advisor within the Clinical Development and Medical Affairs organization.

Reporting to the EM Head of Medical Affairs, the Medical Advisor will be involved in KOL engagement / HCP interactions and provide scientific support to KOLs / HCP to execute core medico-marketing strategies as well as support with Pharmacovigilance activities.

Responsibilities

  • Build a network of key opinion leaders through enhanced scientific interfaces and best practices.

  • Assist in the planning of new campaigns and launch activities.
  • Be a brand ambassador for Biocon Biologics and its products.
  • Safeguard patient benefit always through the application of relevant knowledge of science, regulations, and compliance in all initiatives undertaken by the organization.

  • Promote diversity & inclusion in clinical trials, and data and get involved in ESG objectives as it pertains to medical affairs.

  • Alert the Authority of any emerging safety issue(s) involving registered products.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry.

Position

The Host City Manager will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup TM.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

Host Cities

  • Belo Horizonte
  • Brasília
  • Fortaleza
  • Porto Alegre
  • Recife
  • Rio de Janeiro
  • Salvador
  • São Paulo

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

    Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.

    Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.

    Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

  2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

    Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.

    Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.

    Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

  3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

    Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).

    Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.

    Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

  4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

    Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.

    Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.

    Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.

  5. Reporting and Governance

    Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

Your Profile

Education

Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.

Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differentials

  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)

Requirements

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently.

Main responsibilities

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.

  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.

title: Director, Business Development Lifestyle - Latam
description:
Who We Are

Authentic Brands Group (ABG) is a brand development, marketing and entertainment company, which owns a portfolio of global media, entertainment and fashion lifestyle brands.

ABG elevates and builds the long-term value of more than 50 consumer brands and properties by partnering with best-in-class manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers.

We are committed to transforming brands by delivering compelling product, content, business and immersive experiences.

We create and activate original marketing strategies to drive the success of our brands across all consumer touchpoints, platforms and emerging media.

Why ABG

The mission of ABG is to evolve, transform and reimagine global brands through innovative business models, powerful storytelling, compelling content, and immersive experiences.

Working at ABG isn't like working at other companies.

Let's chat if you're creative and hungry to drive ideas into action.

We work with some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more.

Join us in working toward our mission.

What You’ll Do

As the Business Development Director, Lifestyle LATAM you’ll be developing and executing strategies for expanding ABG’s base of licensing partnerships, increasing the footprint of the company’s brands, and ultimately delivering top‑line revenue for the organization in the LATAM region.

If you’re a strategic thinker with a creative spirit and are driven to win, we’d like to meet you.

We’re proud to offer our BD Executives unlimited commission and are excited to welcome eager sellers to our team.

What You’ll Be Working On

Generate Qualified Leads

  • Learn and understand ABG’s brand strategies.
  • Research the market and identify new Fashion Lifestyle licensing partners that map to your brand portfolio and meet ABG’s partner qualifications.

Build and Manage Sales Pipeline

  • Continually drive prospects into leads through high‑volume outbound sales activity.
  • Utilize detailed discovery to learn about the prospect’s interests and capabilities.
  • Partner with Business Development leadership and Brand Marketing to develop pitch decks that clearly align the brand value proposition with the prospect’s interests and capabilities.

Drive the Licensing Deal to Close

  • Work in partnership with Brand Management and Business Development Leadership teams to develop business plans and formulate product licensing proposals.
  • Lead and manage efficient and productive negotiations of deal terms, taking full ownership of the deal process.
  • Assemble detailed term sheets with concise business terms.
  • Work closely with legal counsel to draft licensing agreements.

Sales Management

  • Track sales activity in CRM consistently and accurately.
  • Manage productive and goal‑oriented deal processes.
  • Prepare accurate sales forecasts per ABG’s sales reporting process.
  • Prepare reports and presentations of sales performance as needed.
  • Responsible for quota attainment in assigned business pillar.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years experience in new business development in licensing for Lifestyle, Beauty, Fashion markets in the LATAM region.
  • 5+ years experience in full‑cycle sales from lead generation through closing the deal in the LATAM region.
  • Have knowledge and understanding of licensees and product categories.
  • Possess an eager demeanor with a fearless and professional drive to win; substantial cold calling and other forms of outreach are required.
  • Success at negotiating licensing contracts, creatively developing new business ideas.
  • Able to partner closely with licensees to understand their business needs and explore opportunities for growth.
  • Understand licensing sales successes and challenges, key retail accounts, development plans and strategy.
  • Understand best practices for Licensees.
  • Has a bachelor’s degree.
  • Must be willing and able to travel occasionally as the role requires.

Authentic Brands Group is an equal‑opportunity employer and we value and embrace diversity and inclusion of all Team Members.

We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, national origin, disability, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or other legally protected status.

title: Inspection Supervisor
description:
Motive Offshore Group specialises in the design, manufacture, rental, and inspection of marine and lifting equipment and is committed to delivering sustainable, innovative, and multi‑sector solutions.

We have many exciting opportunities globally as we rapidly expand our reach, especially in low‑carbon and energy transition areas.

Our People are our most valuable asset.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative, and collaborative workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to achieve their full potential.

We celebrate diversity in all its forms and are dedicated to creating a culture of equity and belonging.

About the role

Hours: Full‑Time

The Inspection Supervisor will lead and supervise all inspection, NDT, and rope‑access activities.

The role includes ensuring full compliance with IRATA Level III rigging and safety requirements.

Duties involve planning, coordinating, and carrying out routine and periodic surveys using the full range of NDT methods and inspection equipment.

Onsite training, mentoring, and performance oversight for Inspectors are also key components of the position, as is undertaking all tasks associated with a Level III Rope Access Supervisor.

Additional responsibilities include ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest technical standards, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and contributing to the development and implementation of inspection procedures and best practices.

Responsibilities

People

Adopt and promote the Motive Offshore Group People Values and ensure their use is embedded throughout.

Develop strong working relations with key stakeholders – clients, colleagues, etc.

Act as a positive ambassador for Motive Offshore Group Ltd.

Uphold the Motive Offshore Group People Values.

Planet

Lead by example in setting the highest possible standards in the promotion of People Values, HSEQ procedures and best practice, ensuring compliance to the Motive Offshore Group HSEQ Policy, procedures, standards and regulatory obligations.

Immediately report all accidents, incidents, near misses or environmental concerns.

Adhere to and participate in company‑wide sustainability policies, procedures and initiatives as they are developed to support our Net Zero objectives.

Product

Provide Rope Access supervision, advice and support.

Perform Rope Access activities and act as Level III Rope Access Supervisor for tasks such as NDT, structural installations and removals, shot blasting and painting.

Rig up and inspect rope access equipment prior to and during use.

Carry out routine surveys, inspections and load testing of lifting equipment and their accessories, and immediately report defects or concerns.

Maintain the compilation of all hours undertaken for rope access activities and report findings to the rope access manager.

Mentor other Spooling and Inspection Rope Access Technicians.

Ensure all rope access equipment is maintained.

Attend rope access refresher and other associated training as required.

Where qualified, carry out visual and NDT examination of all types of high‑performance wire rope.

Where qualified, carry out pressure lubrication of all types of high‑performance wire ropes in accordance with working procedures and COSHH assessments.

Complete Daily Client Service Record and Rope Access forms in full, with accurate times and descriptions, obtaining signed approval from the client where required.

Properly set up equipment.

Use Kinetic Software for the review, approval and production of good‑quality inspection reports ready to send to customers.

Travel to worldwide destinations as and when required.

Required skills / knowledge

Significant offshore experience.

Suitable NDT certification (SNT or PCN Level II).

IRATA Rope Access Level III.

Offshore certification.

Experience operating machinery.

Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.

Ability to prioritise.

Strong organisational skills with a good ability to prioritise and work to deadlines.

Ability to cope with change in a busy working environment.

What we can offer you

As a global business, you will be colleagues with people not only in the UK but also in Taiwan, Singapore, the UAE, Norway, Brazil and the US.

You will be part of our people‑centred approach that supports clients and projects across multiple countries.

Motive has enabled school leavers to advance to senior positions, relocate to other parts of the world, and develop technical skills through training.

How to Apply & what happens next

Send us a resume with any supporting documents telling us why you'd like to work with us at Motive Offshore Group.

Once we've reviewed your application, we'll be back in touch as soon as possible to update you on the next stages.

If you have any questions about the role or want to chat about what life is like at Motive Offshore Group, email us at .

title: Manager, Volunteer Engagement
description:
Join to apply for the Manager, Volunteer Engagement role at FIFA Women's World CupTM

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup TM ("FWWC") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil.

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager will play a central role in shaping, delivering, and elevating the end-to-end communications and engagement strategy for the FIFA Volunteer Programme across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to oversee the development, coordination, and execution of all volunteer-related communications and engagement initiatives.

This includes creating and implementing the overall communications plan, leading launch and promotional campaigns, managing key milestones, and delivering a structured and aligned content plan across both internal and external channels to ensure consistent and impactful communication.

The successful candidate will also drive the engagement strategy covering activations such as the trophy tour, ambassador participation, mascot appearances, and partner‑related activities to further build motivation, visibility, and community among volunteers.

This role will collaborate closely with the Volunteer Management team in FIFA Zurich, eight Host Cities in Brazil, the Brand and Marketing teams, external agencies, and other Functional Areas to ensure consistent, high‑quality messaging and impactful engagement touchpoints throughout the volunteer journey.

This will include all touch points from launch to internal communication to volunteers.

We are seeking an experienced communications professional with a proven track record in managing complex, large‑scale communications campaigns for events and in designing informative, motivating, and culturally relevant engagement initiatives to lead the Volunteer Programme communications for diverse volunteer audiences (local and international) from the application phase through tournament‑time.

The ideal candidate understands the mindset of a volunteer, can translate local context into global communications frameworks, has experience in large‑scale event delivery and thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and implementation of the FWWC27 Volunteer Communications & Engagement Strategy including the initial launch of the volunteer programme.
  • Ensure alignment with FIFA Women’s World Cup strategy, FIFA’s global volunteer communications and engagement strategy, brand guidelines, and tournament timelines.
  • Act as the primary liaison with FIFA Zurich, FIFA 27, Host Cities, and external agencies on topics related to communications and engagement.
  • Deliver key communication and engagement milestones from planning, recruitment through to tournament‑time and post‑event legacy.
  • Co‑lead communications related to the volunteer launch campaign, including messaging, creative briefs, KPIs, and rollout.
  • Draft and prepare engaging written, visual and digital content (in English and Portuguese) throughout the full journey for the volunteer platform, website, social media, FAQs, newsletters, volunteer support channel and operational communications.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Identify opportunities to highlight the Volunteer Programme via Media and Public Relations support.
  • Coordinate and integrate Host Country communications and messaging into a unified, coherent strategy that reflects the tournament’s values, brand, and legacy objectives.
  • Provide Host Cities with communication toolkits, guidelines, and templates.
  • Ensure messaging consistency, accuracy, cultural relevance and crisis communication when required.
  • Ensure all internal and external messaging supports programme goals, celebrates volunteer contributions, and strengthens volunteer satisfaction and retention.
  • Oversee end‑to‑end planning and delivery of assigned communications projects, ensuring alignment between internal teams, host cities, external agencies, and other key partners.
  • Manage external stakeholders and agencies, defining requirements, providing clear briefs, aligning expectations, and ensuring an efficient end‑to‑end RFP process.
  • Lead development and execution of volunteer engagement initiatives including but not limited to trophy tour activations, ambassador and mascot appearances, partner‑related activities and tournament‑time engagement activities in volunteer centres.
  • Prepare and deliver communication and engagement how‑to materials, for FIFA27 and Host City team members to understand how to deliver communication and engagement deliverables.
  • Act as the liaison with Marketing, Brand & Communications teams to ensure consistency in brand, messaging, and tone, while providing cross‑functional support to other divisions including Digital, Media Relations, Content Production, and Event Communications.
  • Track and report performance of communications campaigns, content reach, engagement levels, and activation impact.
  • Provide regular updates to the Senior Volunteer Manager and FIFA27 top management and work closely with the FIFA Zurich team to ensure alignment with the global FIFA Volunteer Programme strategy.
  • Capture lessons learned and feed them into continuous improvement for future events.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5+ years of communications experience, preferably within major events or large‑scale volunteer programmes.
  • University degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business or related field.
  • Masters in Sports Management or Event Management is an asset.
  • Proven experience in delivering FIFA tournaments, major sports events or other international events is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear, engaging messages.
  • Creative thinking with a keen sense for storytelling and brand innovation.
  • Proven expertise in content creation, social media strategy, and media relations.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems and related IT tools is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills with experience delivering campaigns or large‑scale communication plans.
  • Comfortable working with creative tools and platforms (e.g., Adobe Suite, CMS / web design platforms, Photoshop, Final Cut Pro, Audacity).
  • Additional qualification in web design or animation is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and manage relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering audience engagement strategies and activation events.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments; knowledge of Brazil / South America sport and cultural ecosystem is an advantage.
  • Positive, collaborative, solutions‑driven mindset; able to work autonomously and under tight timelines.
  • Team‑oriented and passion for volunteerism, community engagement, diversity, inclusion, and gender empowerment.
  • Experience working with culturally diverse teams across multiple locations / time zones.
  • Understanding of volunteer motivation and behaviour across different cultural contexts.
  • Budget Management and oversee service provider deliverables.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Local Manager
description:
Result of Service

Result of Service

  • The Local Manager reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office.

He / She shall duly and timely perform his / her obligations, under these Terms of Reference.

The consultant will work in close collaboration with UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Petrópolis, RJ, Brazil

Expected duration

Six (6) months with possibility of renewal

Background

The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all.

Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda.

UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity.

It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development.

The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean - ROLAC - is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The agency focuses on developing and managing activities in the host country.

In recent years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil, working with the three levels of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participatory and equitable urban economic, social and environmental policies.

In this context, "Inclusive and Sustainable Rio" is a project between UN-Habitat and the Government of the State of Rio de Janeiro (Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro - GERJ), through the Undersecretariat of Water Resources and Environmental Sustainability (Subsecretaria de Recursos Hídricos e Sustentabilidade Ambiental), which aims to strengthen urban resilience in the State of Rio de Janeiro, based on the implementation of the Agenda and the principles of the New Urban Agenda.

The project will help the State to achieve urban prosperity, while implementing global sustainable urban development agendas.

Specifically, the proposal focuses on: expanding the commitment of the State's direct and indirect administration to accelerate the implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), complementing the Fluminense Government's global call to action - Rio, and establishing a culture of sustainability in the State of Rio de Janeiro that contributes to increasing urban resilience through the development of disaster prevention and mitigation policies and the engagement of local youth.

Therefore, we are looking for a Local Manager to work on the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio project in its product to mobilize the city of Petrópolis and its citizens towards non-structural actions to reduce disaster risks in the city.

Report to UN-Habitat Manager: The Local Manager reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, who will evaluate him / her.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, supervise, guide and support field teams.
  • Provide technical and operational support during activities.
  • Act as the focal point between the project and the community, building trust and collaboration.
  • Promote community awareness of preventive and preparation actions and the role of each group in risky situations.
  • Plan field activities ensuring alignment with community needs.
  • Establish schedules and strategies for efficient execution of actions.
  • Contribute to the actions of field agents, in case of risk of disasters, directing the community population to reception locations.
  • Evaluate field action execution, identify improvement opportunities, and propose adjustments to Field Supervisor.
  • Identify and manage potential conflicts during field operations, seeking quick and effective solutions.
  • Adapt execution strategies according to territorial specifics or unforeseen circumstances.
  • Identify training needs or adjustments for teams and report them to Field Supervisor.
  • Support the training team when they are promoting training with the community in which they will be involved.
  • Develop activities to strengthen community resilience and implement actions to mitigate environmental impacts and reduce disaster risks.
  • Expand educational actions to promote a culture of resilience.
  • Produce monthly reports on personal work activities.
  • Produce detailed monthly reports on field activities, including performance indicators and challenges faced.

Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.

  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role, with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.

  • Rapid Growth : Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

  • You own the outcome : You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame.
  • You level up fast : You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10.
  • You close the loop : You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact.
  • You stay cool under pressure : Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team : You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have :

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.

You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro Nossa história começou em , com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível. Foco no cliente : Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Sonho grande : Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos. Mente aberta : Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre. Espírito empreendedor : Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono. Sobre a Oportunidade: Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos. Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro. Na XP Inc.

Você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro.

Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Pré-requisitos

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI);
  • Diferenciais: Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros); CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;

Job Purpose

In this key leadership role based in our Altens office in Aberdeen, you’ll drive Quality and HSES excellence across Surface UK operations in both Aberdeen and Dunfermline. This role is key to ensuring robust processes and systems that support our business goals and deliver outstanding results.

You’ll champion a culture of continuous improvement, inspiring the right behaviours and fostering collaboration throughout the organization. As a trusted influencer, you’ll build strong relationships while managing and developing the Quality and HSES functions in alignment with TechnipFMC’s strategy, policies, and industry standards.

If you’re passionate about safety, quality, and leadership—and want to shape the future of our operations—this is your opportunity to lead with purpose.

Leadership & Culture

Risk & Change Management

  • Coach teams on risk assessment methodologies.
  • Promote and guide the Management of Change (MOC) process.

Audits & Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits and support regional programs.
  • Prepare for and manage external audits (certification bodies, customer audits).
  • Ensure compliance with API Q2, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and HSE legislation.

Training & Development

  • Deliver QHSES training and awareness initiatives.

Operational Support

  • Encourage proactive hazard identification and reporting.
  • Monitor environmental aspects (waste, emissions, spill prevention).
  • Review client / project documentation and support tender / bid processes.

Security & Emergency Response

  • Act as site Security focal point and emergency response team member.
  • Maintain risk assessments and crisis management plans.

Incident Management

  • Lead investigations using TapRooT, TopSet, and other recognized methodologies.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and develop the Quality team.
  • Foster accountability, safety, and quality across all functions.
  • Support operational readiness and continuous improvement.

Visits to workshop and storage areas required, these environments may be noisy, dusty, subject to temperature variations depending on the season.

May be opportunities to travel to other Surface locations to attend training events, participate in audits, operational meetings.

Experience

Skills & Attributes

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The positon

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

  • Colabora com outras equipes : Trabalha em conjunto com as equipes de produto marketing e desenvolvimento para garantir que as estratégias de monetização estejam alinhadas com os objetivos do aplicativo e com o comportamento dos usuários.
  • Cria relatórios : Prepara relatórios básicos de desempenho para a equipe sênior mostrando os resultados das iniciativas de monetização e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Monitora a concorrência : Pesquisa o que outros aplicativos de recompensas estão fazendo em termos de monetização para ajudar a identificar as melhores práticas.

Sobre a vaga

NaM. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

By combining industry-leading technology, data, and massive scale, we enable busy site owners to seamlessly maximize revenue while freeing themselves of the hassles of ad operations.

  • Elevate the skill set of the Customer Success team by sharing industry knowledge, promoting a culture of learning, and discussing best practices

  • Experience in the AdTech industry and / or a Publisher background

title: Data Analyst
description:
Result of Service

  • He / she will be responsible for developing issues related to data collection and organization and the preparation of thematic maps, a common task in PGIRS and PMSB.

The Data Analyst shall be paid upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office of activities' report related to below mentioned products.

The Data Analyst will work in close collaboration with the Programme Coordinators, the operational and technical teams of UN-Habitat offices in Rio de Janeiro, as well as with the local project team, staff of other UN Agencies, Government officials, media, multilateral and bilateral donors and civil society.

  • Work Location: São Paulo, SP, Brazil
  • Expected duration: Six (6) months upon the signature of the contract, with the possibility of renewal.

Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all.

Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda.

UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity.

It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development.

UN-Habitat's Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean - ROLAC - is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country.

Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative and socially fairer urban economic, social and environmental policies.

As part of a partnership with the Municipality of São Paulo, the project includes the revision of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan (PGIRS) and the elaboration of the Municipal Sanitation Plan (PMSB).

In order to properly implement this project, a Data Analyst is required to ensure that both plans are technically executed correctly.

Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, who will evaluate him / her.

Outputs / Work Assignment The Data Analyst shall support and advise on the implementation of projects according to the responsibilities indicated below.

Responsibilities Under the overall supervision of the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, the consultant will support in : Provide general technical support in relation to the collection and organization of data and mapping for the work developed by the teams at UN-Habitat and the Municipal Government of São Paulo; Identify and organize geographical data related to both PGIRS and PMSB plans; Build a shareable geographic database to be accessed by the consultant team; Identify, collect and organize the data provided in item 12 of the PGIRS and PMSB Work Plan (Product 3.4) and other demands defined by the project coordination; Manipulate and process data according to the team's needs; Update and maintain a shareable database; Create graphs and maps for the diagnostic stage (products 3.5 and 3.9) and the Study of Solutions and Action Plan and Targets stage (products 3.8.1 and ), provided in the Work Plan for the PGIRS and PMSB.

Experience in geographic information systems (GIS)

Organize, facilitate and report on workshops and public hearings to compose products 3.6 and 3.10 of the Work Plan; Create maps based on civil society recommendations; Revise maps from previous reports in accordance with civil society recommendations; Update and review the geographic database based on civil society recommendations.

Qualifications / special skills

  • Academic Qualifications: Required: Bachelor's degree in Geography, Geosciences, Cartographic Engineering, Computer Science or related fields is required or additional 3 (three) years or relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
  • Experience: At least six (6) years of experience in data analysis and preparation of thematic maps.
  • Professional or academic experience in topics related to public policies, public administration, sustainability, social and urban development, public spaces, articulation and coordination of stakeholders in the implementation of policies and projects is a differential.
  • Experience in implementation of participatory workshops and its methodologies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within the UN System would be an asset.
  • Skills: Good computer skills in Windows, as Micros
